Madanapāla
king of the Ṭāka race who ruled over Kāṣṭha on the Yamunā, North of Delhi, father of Pṛthvīmalla (a. of Bālacikitsā) an. Māndhātṛ, (brother of Sahajapāla), son of Sādhāraṇa, son of Hariścandra, son of Bharaṇapāla, son of Ratnapāla. He was patron of Viśveśvara (Madanapārijāta, etc.). Many works written during his reign have been attributed to him.
